svg.text: The context stack, as an OODA loop
Beth Connor · 2026-09-22 · Kohler's three context roles (left) against your actual files (middle). Red = the break. Six decisions on the right.
O
OBSERVE
KOHLER: AMBIENT — raw, uncurated, not scoped in advance
scout_input/ · Condens · Teams Brain Dump · Jira · Confluence
187 files. 55 correctly absent from the index. 72 never examined.
Kohler: "user connects sources; AI sieves for relevance."
✓ The sieve exists — the datadump is the boundary artifact.
PROMOTION HAS NO MECHANISM
Three files declared "User evidence" in their own frontmatter and never crossed. Nothing writes ambient → findings.yaml.
O
ORIENT
KOHLER: LOCAL — scoped to this project · ALICEA: the file pair
findings.yaml
L1 — what happened.
15 rows. Ceilinged, none graded.
✓ the trace log
ux.md
L2 — what we say it means.
problem · cast · evidence
+ world models (was vision)
design.md
L2 — the behaviour.
FLOOR/FIT · context of use
✓ Google Labs name
THE AUTHORING STEP LIVES HERE — and neither half of the system marks it.
Findings do not contain user needs. A need, a concept, a behaviour is authored. It rests on evidence and is not gradeable above it.
MISSING: glossary — Alicea's 5th part. Yours is in CLAUDE.md: the GLOBAL tier, not here.
Global tier (rarely changes, you curate): CLAUDE.md · the constitution · the design system · DO-NOT-CITE
CORRECTIONS DO NOT PROPAGATE BACK UP
C-13: the file that kills the $300/user figure was gathered 3 weeks before the correction and is not reachable from the index carrying it.
D
DECIDE
L3 COMMITMENT — signed, contractual
ACP-HARNESS-INTENT-SPEC.md — §5 Requirements (UXI-##) · §17 signatures
The gate files point AT this; they never restate it. Only ux.md is unconditionally required upstream.
✓ check-gates.sh enforces: a criterion is inherited forward and never dropped.
⚠ …but the inheritance check hardcodes the three filenames instead of reading project.conf.
THIS LINK WORKS
Evidence basis, regime gating, criteria inheritance, §5 resolution, the claim linter — all run, all fail loudly.
A
ACT
BUILD — where code SDD starts, and where it assumes the spec is already right
the product · the prototype · what users actually meet
A UX spec is a claim about humans, so it cannot assume itself correct. That is why Observe and Orient exist at all.
Code SDD has no equivalent of either.
NO RETURN
PATH
DECISIONS TO MAKE
Ordered worst-first. 4–6 are cheap; 1–3 are the system.
Who promotes ambient → findings?
A shelf declaration in a file is not a promotion. Does the
refresh ritual write the row, or does a human? Nothing does now.
Where does a correction land?
A killed figure has to reach every surface quoting it.
Candidate: superseded_by + a reverse index off findings.yaml.
Where does a frame correction go?
When a premise changes, everything beneath it needs re-reading.
No slot for this anywhere — not in the gate files, not in §0–§20.
Fold vision.md into ux.md?
Recommend yes — Alicea's UX.md has the slot ("world models").
Cost: need and bet share a file, which is where a business case
in user-need clothing hides best. Keep both gate rubrics separate.
Glossary: global or local?
Alicea puts it in UX.md. Yours is in CLAUDE.md. Product
vocabulary is probably per-product — so local. Your call.
Fix the hardcoded filenames?
check-gates.sh:667–682 greps for ux/vision/design.md while
check_optional_gate reads project.conf. Any rename → green
and blind. Not blocking now that #4 keeps the names.
ALREADY SETTLED — STOP RE-DECIDING
· File names. ux.md + design.md are Alicea's own pair. No rename.
· No context.md. "Context" spans all three of Kohler's roles, so
it cannot be scoped to one file without re-importing ambiguity.
· vision and ux are both INTERPRETATIONS of research, not one
derived from the other.
· A vision on secondary evidence runs honestly at LOW. The defect
is only LOW travelling downstream unmarked.
· claim_scope resolves volume: convergence supports existence and
pattern, never prevalence. Volume widens scope, not confidence.
· Only the researcher of record sets a grade. The script computes
the ceiling and refuses anything above it.
Sources: Kohler, "The 3 Roles of Context for AI Agents" (NN/g, 2026-09-18) · Alicea, "UX-Context Design" (NN/g, 2026-07-24) · Perez, "Context Architecture" (NN/g, 2026-06-12).
Breaks 1 and 2 are findings in acp-core-testrepo/findings.yaml (datadump-understates-its-own-user-shelf · counterevidence-exists-but-is-unindexed). Working: datadump-refresh-2026-09-22.md.
Perez names the question "which sources should be trusted more?" and gives only document-level hierarchy. findings.yaml answers it per claim, arithmetically. That is the contribution.
